messages:
elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  Thanks for the great questions. Sharing clarifications, owners, and a compact action list so teams can pick up work this week.

sam: Appreciate the clarity on Dedicated timeline. Two quick asks: 1) can we publish the autoscale test plan so customers know the validation rigor; 2) what's the rollback window post-GA?

elena: Short answers: 1) yes, the test plan will be public in the infra repo; 2) rollback policy: 24-48 hour soft rollback window for major regressions, documented in the GA FAQ. We'll include both links in comms.

matt: On autoscale tests: plan is 3 phased storm tests (small/med/large), cross-region, with KV cache warm/cold scenarios. I'll post the test matrix on Monday. Owners: matt + eng-sre.

jia: Canary details: we'll run 3 canary ramps: 100 orgs -> 1k req/min -> 10k req/min. Eval signals: latency P95, error rate, token-cost delta, and a functionality check from our prompt suites. I own the eval pass/fail rule.

oliver: Rollout ops will include routing-policy safeguards: region pinning, model-fallback to smaller quantized variant, and circuit break thresholds. I'll write the routing-policy RFC and add the implementation checklist.

lina: Docs: quickstart draft up today. Need SE review and two techwriter passes. Suggest we add a "working with Dedicated" troubleshooting section for common errors (quota, TLS, routing).

doc-bot: Quickstart draft: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated-quickstart-draft (comments enabled).

sam: For comms: do we have a short FAQ entry about SLA differences between Hosted vs Dedicated? Customers asked during Q&A.

elena: Yes. Product will publish an SLA comparison table and a short FAQ. I'll draft it and post for review.

matt: Action summary (brief):
- Matt / Eng-SRE: publish autoscale test matrix + run storm tests (due 2026-06-04).
- Jia: finalize canary ramps and eval pass criteria (due 2026-06-02).
- Oliver: routing-policy RFC + fallback section (due 2026-06-03).
- Lina / Docs: complete quickstart review + troubleshooting section (due 2026-05-31).
- Elena / Product: SLA table + GA FAQ (due 2026-06-05).

jia: Note: we'll include a short post-canary report template so we can standardize acceptance. I'll draft that template and link it to the eval dashboard.

oliver: I'll add the fallback details to the RFC and call out supported fallback models and expected latencies.

eng-sre: I'll create the public perf dashboard issue and wire the p50/p95/p99 charts. Linking the issue when done.

elena: Links from the meeting: deck + recording: https://drive.redwood/allhands/may-2026-deck, meeting notes: https://confluence.redwood/allhands-may-2026-notes, quickstart draft: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated-quickstart-draft, evals dashboard: https://dash.redwood/evals/dedicated-canary.

elena: If anyone else should be added to an action, drop a note here and I'll update the owners. Thanks again  great discussion today :party_parrot:
